title: Composition of the point-scalar realization comparison
statement: For an affine scheme T, with the component functor and coefficient transport of [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model], suppose a is a section-ring isomorphism, the section realization square holds, and profinite point realization followed by componentDerived equals affine point realization. Then affine point realization is naturally isomorphic to affine section-ring realization after derived scalar extension along the composite of the profinite point-scalar map and a.

proof.text: Compose the inverse point comparison, the profinite scalar realization isomorphism whiskered by componentDerived, the section square whiskered by point scalar extension, and the derived scalar composition isomorphism. Functor associators supply the intermediate parenthesizations.

mathlib_searches.results: SheafOfModules.sheafificationCompPullback, Sheaf.ΓHomEquiv, PresheafOfModules.pullback, and restriction-of-scalars APIs; no derived component realization square.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No direct match for the fixed functors; reuse the stated library comparison interfaces.

theorem component_final_scalar_comparison
    (a : Evaluation.A ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace T))
      (profiniteCoefficient Λ (affineComponentSpace T)) (Over.mk (𝟙 (affineComponentSpace T))) ≅
      Evaluation.A (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ T)
        (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T)))
    (square : Nonempty (Evaluation.F
        ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace T))
        (profiniteCoefficient Λ (affineComponentSpace T)) (Over.mk (𝟙 (affineComponentSpace T)))
        Over.mkIdTerminal ⋙ componentDerived Λ T α ≅
      RingDerivedScalarExtension.moduleDerivedExtension a.hom.hom ⋙
        Evaluation.F (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ T)
          (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T))
          (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @AlgebraicGeometry.WeaklyEtale T)))
    (point : Nonempty (profiniteScalarRealization Λ (affineComponentSpace T) ⋙
        componentDerived Λ T α ≅ condensedScalarRealization Λ T)) :
    Nonempty (condensedScalarRealization Λ T ≅
      RingDerivedScalarExtension.moduleDerivedExtension
          (a.hom.hom.comp (profiniteScalarMap Λ (affineComponentSpace T))) ⋙
        Evaluation.F (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ T)
          (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T))
          (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @AlgebraicGeometry.WeaklyEtale T))
